doc.id: SUBANIM_* index (the subanimation id in a battle_anim command)
doc.type: SUBANIMTYPE_* (the 3 high bits of the header byte). How it is applied (LoadSubanimation / DrawFrameBlock): on the player's turn every type except ENEMY plays NORMAL; on the enemy's turn the type itself is used; ENEMY means HFLIP on the player's turn and NORMAL on the enemy's
doc.entries: frame blocks in play order (REVERSE plays them last to first)
doc.entries[].mode: FRAMEBLOCKMODE_*: 00 = draw, wait delay, wait 1 more frame, clear OAM, next block starts at OAM slot 0; 02 = draw only (no wait), next block appends after it; 03 = draw, wait delay, keep OAM, next block appends; 04 = draw, wait delay, keep OAM, next block overwrites from the same slot; 01 behaves like 00
